svg.title: Twenty thousand freight cars in a thousand slots, two ways
svg.desc: Two bar charts of how many freight cars land in each of a thousand slots. Top: slot chosen by the car number's last three digits, with tall spikes at slots 0, 100 and 500 holding hundreds of cars, and most other slots far below average. Bottom: slot chosen by mixing all the digits, with every slot close to the average of twenty.
svg.text: Slot 000 holds every car whose number ends in 000; fullest slot: 481 cars
Similar numbers land far apart; fullest slot: 38 cars
Illustrative car numbers, issued in blocks as in the story; the dashed line is the average, 20 per slot.
